title: Relieving Factors
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. positions.as_written: Ask what they do when it hurts, rather than offering rest, ice or tablets as options.
Ask how long it takes to settle, in minutes or hours.
Ask whether analgesia helps, which, and how much, since a complete lack of response to simple analgesia is informative.
Ask whether a brace, a stick, strapping or particular footwear helps, because a positive answer points at mechanics and at a possible non-operative route.
Ask whether rest has been tried properly, since a patient who has never rested the knee cannot say whether rest helps.
At decision level a relieving factor is a natural experiment the patient has already run, and it should be used as one.
And a knee relieved only by opiates, in the presence of modest findings, should prompt a broader assessment rather than a mechanical intervention.
